sar.narrative: This report concerns suspected fraud following an undocumented coordinated pattern on card C11663-K1 held by customer C11663 (internal case AC-HHF-003, opened 2017-01-31). Between 2017-01-22 and 2017-01-31 the card was used for 7 transaction(s) totalling $8,551.47: on 2017-01-22 $181.73 online in billing region 327.0; on 2017-01-23 $357.82 online in billing region 327.0; on 2017-01-24 $811.92 online in billing region 327.0; on 2017-01-26 $1,800.00 online in billing region 327.0; on 2017-01-27 $1,800.00 online in billing region 327.0; on 2017-01-28 $1,800.00 online in billing region 327.0; on 2017-01-31 $1,800.00 online in billing region 315.0. The activity matches a coordinated undocumented wave across 8 cards sharing the signature (Dormant wake + un-identitied online ProductCD='C' doubling ramp to $1,800 ceiling). The other connected cards in this wave are C03080-K2, C04096-K1, C07847-K1, C08563-K1, C08943-K2, C09026-K1, C09148-K1. The cardholder reported that they did not make the purchase and still hold the card. The activity is inconsistent with the cardholder's history (prior median purchase $91.98). No prior report has been filed on this customer. OFAC SDN screening of the customer identifier: no match (anonymised identifiers; screening result recorded from the sdn.csv lookup in the live run). Recommended actions: a block and reissue of the card, not yet done and awaiting fraud-manager approval, internal case opened, 7 connected cards placed under monitoring, case escalated to an analyst.
